Name: Trapper's Hat
Author: Tritan21
Description:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[size=6][u][b]Trapper's Hat
[/b][/u][/size][size=4]A winter favorite, the trapper's hat has many names and is used by a wide variety of cultures.
(Some call it a ushanka or an aviator hat)

This is my first mod and I'm extremely new, please back up your saves just to be safe. I made this mod because I was disappointed in the winter hat selection provided by vanilla Stardew Valley and the Mod Nexus.

This mod adds a new winter hat, which you can buy from the Hat Mouse for 2,000 gold.[/size]

[size=6][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/size]
[size=4]1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Download and install the latest version of Json Assets
3. Download and install the latest version of this mod
4. Use Vortex to 'install' everything, then 'enable' everything.
5 .Deploy/elevate your mods in vortex and start the game through SMAPI[/size]

[size=6][u][b]Manual Installation[/b][/u][/size]
[size=4]1. Download and install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Download and install the latest version of Json Assets
3. Download this mod and open the rar file
4. Place the folder, found in the rar file, in your Stardew Valley mods folder
[/size][size=4]5. Run the game through SMAPI
[/size]

Downloads.Description:
A Json Assets content pack.

For Stardew Valley 1.5.4 or later.
